text: Nineteen forty-six. Britain pastes one big patch over the Malay states, and calls it the Malayan Union.
asr: 1946. Britain pastes one big patch over the Malay states and calls it the Malayan Union.

text: The Malays won't have it. And the patch won't lie flat.
asr: The malaise won't have it. And the patch won't lie flat.

text: Ten years later, in London, both sides agree on a date.
No war. Just talks, and a lot of paper.
